name: Brazil National Banking / Accrual Holidays (ANBIMA)

rules.name: National Black Consciousness Day (national holiday from 2024)

notes: ANBIMA national banking-holiday convention for business-day accrual. Excludes municipal holidays, elections and year-end customer-service closures; Dec 24 and Dec 31 remain accrual business days when weekdays. This is not the B3 listed-market trading calendar. <https://www.anbima.com.br/feriados/> . Exceptional and historical rule changes outside the published fixtures are not certified.
